method: Each original marketing WEBP and each of four original endpoint PNGs inspected separately through vision_analyze; no contact-sheet substitution. Source readmes read for context.
overall_findings: No unmistakable framing failure, UI overlap, missing major mesh or severe intersection visible in the supplied endpoints. No reproducible runtime defect established by this still-image review.
Richer promotional materials are artistic differences, not runtime-defect evidence.
Lid-top ornaments visible closed are occluded behind raised lid in front-open views; absence in open screenshots is not missing content.
Static screenshots do not verify motion, reset, zoom, connectivity, accessibility or physical-phone performance. Readme test claims were not rerun.

source_readme.relevant_disclosures: Discloses stylized enamel/porcelain, tile-like floes, architectural ridges, weak pond readability and source/runtime lighting differences.

images.observation: Blue contour-patterned chest, brass hardware and pale ice slabs; frosted/translucent-looking rear blocks and turquoise patches are richer than runtime.
Whole model and UI contained. Floes read as flat tiles and rear ridges as cuboids; body tracery is busy; dark feet have weak separation.
Whole open silhouette and projecting latch contained; cavity and two hinge locations visible. Plain turquoise underside obscures lid-top ice, as expected for this camera.
Title wraps cleanly, controls and footer fit. Tile-like floes remain visible; pond identity and tiny fittings are weak at this scale.
Open model and controls remain contained; body detail is smaller and hinge attachment hard to read. No unmistakable missing faces or overlap.

artistic_limitations: Opaque enamel-like ice rather than promotional translucency.
Quadrilateral floes, architectural rear blocks and competing body tracery weaken naturalistic ice/pond reading.
unconfirmed_inspection_points: Open-view hinge/rail joins and projecting released latch are visually schematic; endpoint stills do not establish broken connectivity or collision. Side view and motion inspection would be required to escalate.
presentation_limitations: Small secondary UI text across desktop/mobile; accessibility contrast not measured.
Fine edges/hardware lose clarity at mobile screenshot scale.
reviews.reason: Preserve existing hold; visual limitations require user judgment, not technical-failure inference.

Cream stone, teal inset and shell/pearl clearly readable. Full object fits; dark teal lid seam is conspicuous but coherent with trim, not established misalignment.
Open chest, rim, hinges and upper latch fully framed; plain cream underside hides shell/pearl on far side. No UI collision or clear mesh failure.
Shell and pearl still identifiable; title leaves Stone on second line but fits. Fine shell ribs and fittings are slightly jagged/small.
Cavity, lid and controls contained. Rim joints chunky and hinge mounting difficult to resolve at this scale; no confirmed detached part.

artistic_limitations: Shell ribs read scallop-like rather than accurate oyster anatomy.
Cream stone is soft/mottled rather than richly pearlescent; brass seating details are subtle on mobile.

Fine edges/hardware lose clarity at mobile screenshot scale.

Entire chest and landscape framed; house, hills and shrub rows legible. Bamboo is regular/repetitive and green seam conspicuous; no clear unintended gap.
Full open silhouette and empty cavity contained; patterned lid underside visible, landscape hidden behind lid. Hinges visible, no proven detachment.
Title and controls fit. House and cultivated hill remain visible, but shrub species depends on context; thin hardware and foliage edges mildly pixel-stepped.
Full model and UI contained; repeated bamboo lines dominate and hinge details are small. No unmistakable missing face, clipping or intersection.

Shrubs are generic rounded clusters, not independently identifiable coffee plants.
Low rolling relief and simple farmhouse are symbolic rather than dramatic or geographic mountains.
